title: IndicDetect: Evaluating Cross-Lingual LLM-Generated Text Detection for Hindi, Telugu, and Tamil
abstract: arXiv:2608.29919v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The rapid proliferation of LLMs has further heightened the need to develop dependable AI-generated text detection, especially beyond English. Nevertheless, current benchmarks pay little attention to Indic languages and test detectors in idealized settings that do not represent the real world. We present a generalized benchmark for AI-generated text detection in Hindi, Telugu, and Tamil, which we call IndicDetect, designed to assess the robustness of detectors under realistic distribution shifts. IndicDetect comprises highly curated human-written texts matched with LLM-generated counterparts across various domains and generators, and systematically evaluates detectors in the presence of domain shift, generator shift, and adversarial perturbation. Using a single and repeatable evaluation scheme, we evaluate a wide range of statistical and neural detectors. We find substantial robustness failures: supervised neural detectors perform well

translated_title: IndicDetect：评估针对印地语、泰卢固语和泰米尔语的跨语言LLM生成文本检测
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的快速普及进一步凸显了开发可靠的人工智能生成文本检测技术的必要性，尤其是在英语以外的语言领域。然而，当前的基准测试很少关注印度语言，并且通常在脱离现实世界的理想化设置中测试检测器。我们提出了一个针对印地语、泰卢固语和泰米尔语的人工智能生成文本检测的通用基准，称为IndicDetect，旨在评估检测器在现实分布偏移下的鲁棒性。IndicDetect包含精心整理的人类撰写文本及其对应的LLM生成文本，涵盖多个领域和多种生成器，并系统地在领域偏移、生成器偏移和对抗性扰动的情况下评估检测器。使用统一且可重复的评估方案，我们评估了广泛的统计类和神经类检测器。我们发现检测器存在显著的鲁棒性缺陷：有监督神经检测器在……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了IndicDetect基准，系统评估印地语、泰卢固语和泰米尔语中AI生成文本检测器在领域偏移、生成器偏移和对抗性扰动等现实分布偏移下的鲁棒性，并发现现有检测器存在显著的鲁棒性缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces IndicDetect, a benchmark for evaluating the robustness of AI-generated text detectors in Hindi, Telugu, and Tamil under realistic distribution shifts (domain shift, generator shift, and adversarial perturbation), revealing substantial robustness failures in existing detectors.
